items.title: Intel’s Best Growth in 15 Years: 25% Revenue Surge and Our New Price Target
items.summary: Intel just posted its strongest revenue growth in over 15 years, yet shares sit more than 30% below their recent peak after a massive stock offering rattled investors. Whether that gap is a buying opportunity or a warning sign depends entirely on one unresolved question about its foundry business.

items.title: Hold Intel And Strictly Follow These Binary Catalysts
